scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @onroad/backend" "npm run dev -w @onroad/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @onroad/backend && npm run build -w @onroad/frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w @onroad/backend && npm run test -w @onroad/frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start -w @onroad/backend" "npm run start -w @onroad/frontend"
